regressions.claim: I56's outputs do not move: python -m holon games run --check prints CHECK OK, and no file under results/M5/games/, gen/M5/games/ or laws/M5/games/ changes in I56b's own commits.
The truth is the pinned one: spec/M5/truth/corpus.json and spec/M5/truth/corpus.run.json hash to thresholds.pins, and I54b's audit stays PREREG OK.
The truth's L6 values are 1 irrational (c05) and 19 undocumented.

thresholds.base_note: the I56 branch after merging I54b's corpus-truth commit 29526bea (PR #136) as the lead allowed; I56's key and outputs are not changed

definitions.determinism: python -m holon games corpus --check regenerates both files byte for byte
definitions.mapping: I54's definitions.L6.corpus_mapping, unchanged: a finding is a corpus item iff its record comes from a run on the entry's pre-fix commit (I51) and its law's source spans meet a line the entry's fix changes; each entry with truth rational or irrational contributes one item per mapped finding; an undocumented entry contributes none
definitions.pre_fix_runs: I51's runs are the rows of results/eval/holon/corpus.json (BUILD_PLAN I51's exit file) and the result records they name. When that file does not exist, no entry maps any finding, and the corpus has 0 items
definitions.score: L6 by holon.games.metric.l6_v9 (I54's l6 after V9) with corpus_truth = {item: truth} over the mapped items and corpus_expect their expectations; results/M5/corpus/l6_corpus.json holds that report, and results/M5/corpus/mapping.json holds per entry its truth, its pre-fix commit (the fix_commit's first parent, named, not resolved), its mapped findings and the reason when none
definitions.truth: an entry's L6 truth is spec/M5/truth/corpus.json entries[<id>].l6, read as given: rational, irrational or undocumented. An undocumented answer, or one the labellers disagreed on (which the truth file records as undocumented), is never resolved here; c13 is excluded (spec/M5/lib/truth_protocol.json known_exclusions)
